# `list_plan`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

List the legacy autosave plans in brief.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER / established (64-bit build; 32-bit build probable) |
| Side-effect tier | A |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xb47f0 (64-bit build) |

Returns id, name, enabled flag and target count of every legacy plan. No request parameters are read. An empty array was OBSERVED during an imaging run (2026-10-12), so it does not identify the ViewPlan state either.

Side effects: Copies the plan map under its lock into a local map and serializes summaries; nothing is written. The lock wait has no explicit timeout.

## Request params

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"list_plan"`. [READ] |
| `params` | any | no | - | Not read. Omission, null, object, scalar and array take the same path. Clients SHOULD omit it. [READ] |

| `Timestamp` | string | no | - | (both) Decimal string `<seconds>.<nanoseconds>` with exactly nine fractional digits, formatted with `%ld.%09ld` from clock_gettime clock id 1. Linux clock id 1 is CLOCK_MONOTONIC, so the value is monotonic time, not wall-clock or Unix time (INFERRED from the clock id). On replies it is added by the socket layer and is normally present; receivers MUST NOT require it on replies (absent on a stop_func relay-failure reply). ## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 268 | The plan loader thread is running | `operation is in progress` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

## Example

Request, list - Typical request:

```json
{"id":51,"method":"list_plan"}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"list_plan","result":[{"id":1,"plan_name":"Example plan","enable":true,"target_cnt":2}],"code":0,"id":51}
```

Reply, ok-empty:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"list_plan","result":[],"code":0,"id":52}
```
